node.statement: Apply lem-stage1-rectified-cstar-control to the algebra fixed in the preceding step. It supplies on the same involutive normed space a bilinear product bold-dot and J=J^dagger satisfying every exact-unit alpha-C*-algebra axiom, including ||J||=1, with alpha=c*epsilon_X, and satisfying ||J-I_X|| <= c*epsilon_X and ||x bold-dot y-xy|| <= c*epsilon_X*||x||*||y|| for every x,y.
